# Frankie 1.1.20
- Computer Runs now pause for user-required prompts and resume with their existing history, records, and remaining budget. - Work conversations can stop, steer, or resume the active Mac run and automatically continue compound tasks after it finishes. - Collected records remain readable and can be saved into a requested Prospecting Workspace. - Loop detection now catches reworded repeats and two-step oscillation, and long pauses force a fresh screen plan. - Frankie now states clearly that native Safari control uses the foreground Mac; isolated Chromium remains the option for browser work that does not take the user's mouse and keyboard.
